claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User initiates the process to add, modify, or delete Voucher Service Provider records.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the process to add, modify, or delete Voucher Service Provider records.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the Voucher Service Provider (VSP) Master Information module to add, modify, or delete provider records.

To add a new record, the user selects the 'New' option and enters mandatory details including VSP Code (auto-generated), Provider Name, Physical and Communication Addresses, Health Sub-District, Locality, Level and Type of Facility, Registration Body, Contact Person, Designation, Contact No, E-Mail ID, and Status.

The system validates entries: it auto-generates the VSP code with suffix 'SP', checks for duplicate provider names (prompting 'Continue – Yes/No'), and ensures all fields except Contact No and E-Mail ID are filled.

If location or facility master data (e.g., District, Sub-District, County) is missing during entry, the system allows the user to navigate to the respective master screen to add the missing data and return to the VSP screen.
To modify an existing record, the user selects the 'Edit' option, updates the desired fields, and saves; the system re-applies validation rules.
To delete a record, the user selects the 'Delete' option; deletion is permitted only if no child records (e.g., claims or transactions) are linked to the provider.
Upon successful save, the system confirms the operation and updates the VSP master database.

If the user attempts to create a new VSP with an existing provider name, the system displays a message with options 'Continue – Yes/No'; if 'Yes' is selected, the system allows saving the duplicate name; if 'No', the system prevents saving the new entry.

If any required location data (District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town) or facility-related master data (Health Sub-District, Locality, Level of Facility, Type of Facility, Registration Body) is not available during VSP creation, the system provides a provision to navigate quickly to the respective master screen, enter the missing details, and return to the VSP screen.
If the user tries to create a new VSP with an existing provider name, the system displays a message with options 'Continue – Yes/No'; selecting 'No' prevents saving the entry.

If required location or facility master data (e.g., District, Sub-District, County, Health Sub-District, Locality, Level/Type of Facility, Registration Body) is not available during VSP creation, the system allows the user to navigate to the respective master screen to add the missing data and return to the VSP screen; failure to add required data blocks completion.
Deletion of a VSP record is not permitted if child records (e.g., claims or transactions) are linked to the provider; the system blocks the operation in this case.
The VSP master database is updated with the new or modified provider record.
The system displays a confirmation message indicating the successful completion of the add, modify, or delete operation.
If a VSP record is deleted, it is confirmed that no child records (such as claims or transactions) are linked to the provider.
The status of a VSP may be automatically set to 'In-Active' if more than two fraud entries are detected during the claim process for that provider.
